sections.title: Say what you have to do
sections.content: Use tener que + infinitive to express a personal obligation.

items.english: I have to write a report.

items.spanish: Tenemos que ir a la oficina.
items.english: We have to go to the office.

sections.content: Tener que changes for the person. The second verb stays in the infinitive: tengo que trabajar, tienes que trabajar, tiene que trabajar.
